lines: A module is delivered more than once inside a single page:
libresign-main: 2,312 B beyond the first copy, @vueuse/core 2,019 B, @vueuse/shared 293 B.
libresign-external: 2,312 B beyond the first copy, @vueuse/core 2,019 B, @vueuse/shared 293 B.
libresign-validation: 2,312 B beyond the first copy, @vueuse/core 2,019 B, @vueuse/shared 293 B.
libresign-init: 14,850 B beyond the first copy, @nextcloud/files 11,057 B, @vueuse/core 1,996 B, @vueuse/shared 832 B.
All 6 pages load the same 1 file: 180,730 B raw, 69,492 B gzip, 48.7 % of the smallest page (libresign-tab, 371,139 B).
Inside: @vue/runtime-core 64,557 B, dompurify 30,475 B, @vue/runtime-dom 24,591 B, @vue/reactivity 17,982 B, @vue/shared 13,858 B.
moment, 301,425 B on the libresign-main page: carries its locale data; luxon and date-fns are a fraction of it.
vite-plugin-node-polyfills, 57,292 B on the libresign-main page: Node APIs polyfilled into a browser bundle.
No package is imported as a whole: every package contributes only the modules that are used (196 packages, 1,376 modules).
On this measure the form of importing is exhausted. A root import whose barrel the bundler removes completely leaves no trace, so this is evidence, not proof.
No bundler chunk in js and css is left without something that loads it.
